import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: No bees, or used bee supplies or equipment, shall be shipped or moved into the state without a certificate signed by a legally authorized inspector that they are free from any infectious or contagious disease.

combless_package_import_exemption.quote: Bees and queen in mailing cages shall be considered as a colony for the purposes of this subdivision.

regulated_diseases.quote: develop a program for the control of American foulbrood disease of honeybees through the fumigation of hives and such other measures as will control such disease

right_of_entry_scope.quote: The inspector shall have free access at all reasonable hours to all apiaries or other premises where bees, bee products, supplies or appliances used in apiaries are kept

honey_product_labeling_standards.quote: Every shipment, package or container of honey packed, sold, offered or exposed for sale or distribution by any person shall be plainly marked for packaging and labeling, and shall include: (a) The name, address and zip code of the packer, distributor, or producer; (b) The true name of the product; (c) The grade, or the term "not graded"; and (d) The volume of the contents

honey_adulteration_prohibited.quote: Honey which is labeled as being pure honey and which is produced, packaged, handled or sold in this state shall not in any way be adulterated with cane sugar, corn sugar, or any other foreign sweetener.

pesticide_spray_restriction_near_blossom.quote: It shall be unlawful to use any poisonous material in the form of spray or dust upon fruit trees, shade trees, or shrubs that are in blossom

inspection_fee_charged.quote: They shall establish reasonable fees for providing disease control services to owners of bees in this state and in adjoining states.
